proves.claim: pipelineWatchModel carries project.clock and returns null when the project has no clock.

view.logic-pipeline-watch.clock-model.why: Without this case the watch could show a fabricated clock or lose the clock delivered by board state.

proves.claim: pipelineWatchHtml renders the without-owner alarm pill, overdue count and age, and each named stuck group clock deadline and default move.

view.logic-pipeline-watch.clock-html.why: Without this case clock alarms and the board's next moves could disappear from the Pipeline watch.
